name: foundryvtt-module-manifest

manifest.description: A stable URL that describes the latest release version of your manifest file. This URL is used for automatic module installation in the Foundry VTT setup screen. This manifest URL is consulted during the module update check to see whether a new version is available for download. It is important that this address remain stable, otherwise updates will not be detected.

library.description: The library field is a boolean that indicates whether the package is a library intended for other packages to depend on and consume. This field should be true if your package does not present any user-facing features, but rather provides functionality for other packages to utilize and rely upon. Packages with this field set to true may be hidden from third party package lists to avoid confusing users. When omitted the default value of this field is false.

description:
My Awesome Module (id = “my-awesome-module”, name = “my-awesome-module”) is a community‑created Foundry VTT add‑on authored by Jane Doe. Currently at version 1.4.2 and released under the MIT license, it requires at least core version 10 and is compatible through core version 12. The module’s purpose is to enrich fantasy campaigns with new weapons, items, and a range of quality‑of‑life features, and it is described as “A Foundry VTT module that adds new weapons, items, and quality‑of‑life features for fantasy campaigns.” The official manifest can be found at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/janedoe/my-awesome-module/main/module.json, the downloadable zip at https://github.com/janedoe/my-awesome-module/releases/download/v1.4.2/module.zip, and the project home page at https://github.com/janedoe/my-awesome-module. This package is not a library (library = false) and does not provide core translations (coreTranslation = false).

The module loads two script files – scripts/main.mjs and scripts/helpers.js – and supplies two content packs. The first pack, “my-awesome-weapons” (label = “Awesome Weapons”), is an Item‑type pack for the dnd5e system stored at packs/weapons.db. The second pack, “my-awesome-actors” (label = “Awesome Actors”), is an Actor‑type pack for the same system located at packs/actors.db. In its relationship section the module declares compatibility with the dnd5e system (type = compatible) and points to the system’s manifest at https://foundryvtt.com/releases/system/dnd5e/module.json. Finally, the module’s flag namespace “my-awesome-module” contains a single flag, someFlag, set to true.
